positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full-stack developer working on features necessary for our initial release. This includes frontend React and Java script work, backend C#, MSSQL, and Postgresql work, and help with automated and manual testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Add and improve features on the current software products, work on increasing the modularity of the current code, and develop unit test suites as needed.

company.name: CERT Division at the Software Engineering Institute

positions.title: Professional Services Coop
positions.description: Working on the various projects that the professional service employees are not able to undertake while working with customers. The two main projects I focused o was a data delete utility an an auto generated word file based off of user input. The data delete utility allows for both employees and customers to delete clients, pairs, or lists in a specified database. The utility was designed as a wizard to make it a simple step by step process for customers. The auto generated word file was already coded, but needed a lot of fixing. the main part I fixed dealt with reading a .mpj file and parsing that data into a table on the word file.
